entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I need to return something, my VeloBand tracker. I was looking on your website and I'm just so confused by everything. I don't know what I'm supposed to do.
I can certainly help you look into a return. Not a problem at all. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's not broken. It's just... it's not what I thought it would be. It's a bit complicated for me. I know I've had it for a few weeks, but honestly, everything has been a complete mess here.
I see. And I'm sorry to hear things have been difficult. Can you help me understand what happened?

Well, my husband is on military deployment, and right after I got this, we had a huge family emergency. His father needed sudden surgery and was in the hospital for almost three weeks. I've been running back and forth dealing with that. The last thing on my mind was this return policy. Can't you just help me?

I completely understand, and I'm very sorry to hear about your father-in-law's surgery and the stress you've been under. Let me pull up your account and check the return eligibility right now. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. It looks like the VeloBand was delivered on December 15th, which was 32 days ago.
See? I knew it was too long. It's just been one thing after another.

Actually, you have nothing to worry about. I'm looking at our return policy right here, and you are well within the 90-day return window. We can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you.
Oh! Really? Ninety days? I thought I read something else. That... that's such a relief. Thank you so much.

You are very welcome. I'm happy I could clear that up and get this sorted out for you. I've just sent a prepaid return label and instructions to the email we have on file. You'll just need to print it, pack the VeloBand in its original box, and drop it off.
That's wonderful. Thank you, Charlie. You've been a great help.
It was my pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
